Olympic Park will be bustling on Sunday with 80,000 people attending events across the precinct including 60,000 footy fans converging on Accor Stadium for the NRL Semi Final blockbuster. Thousands of people will also be attending the Oz Comic-Con at Sydney Showground and a basketball event at Qudos Bank Arena. 

  • NRL Semi Final: Bulldogs v Panthers at Accor Stadium. Kick-off 4.05pm, full time around 5.50pm.
  • Pavlos Giannakopoulos Tournament at Qudos Bank Arena. Games start from 4.30pm, event finish by 9pm.
  • ﻿Oz Comic-Con at Sydney Showground on Saturday 20 and Sunday 21 September. Event runs daily from 9am to 5pm.

With large crowds expected, there will be significant traffic delays on roads approaching the precinct. Motorists should allow plenty of extra travel time on roads including the M4 Mwy, Homebush Bay Dr, Concord Rd, Lane Cove Rd, Parramatta Rd, Centenary Dr and Silverwater Rd.

**PARKING IS SOLD OUT: all available pre-booked parking spaces are sold out in Olympic Park for Sunday 21 September. If you have pre-booked your parking, follow the directions of staff and have your parking ticket ready to show at the car park entry. If you have not pre-booked, do not drive to the precinct. Consider parking at a nearby train station commuter car park and continuing your trip by train to Olympic Park, at no extra cost.

Roads closures:

Sydney Olympic Park Authority will close local roads in the precinct and traffic congestion is expected before and after the events. For road closure details, visit the Sydney Olympic Park Authority interactive map.
